name: Tesla
summary: Electric vehicles. Radical subtraction, cinematic full-viewport photography, Universal Sans

colors.name: Electric Blue
colors.role: Primary CTA button background — a confident, mid-saturation blue (rgb 62, 106, 225) that stands alone as the only chromatic color in the entire interface. Used exclusively for "Order Now" and other primary action buttons

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Dominant background color for all surfaces, panels, navigation, and secondary button fills — the canvas that lets photography breathe

colors.name: Promo Blue
colors.role: Blue also serves for promotional text ("0% APR Available") displayed over hero imagery in the same hue as the CTA — creating a visual link between incentive messaging and action

colors.name: White Canvas
colors.role: Page background, navigation panel, dropdown menus, and all surface containers

colors.name: Light Ash
colors.role: Subtle alternate surface for section differentiation — barely perceptible shift from pure white (rgb 244, 244, 244)

colors.name: Carbon Dark
colors.role: Dark surface color for hero text overlays and potential dark-mode contexts (rgb 23, 26, 32) — a warm near-black with a blue undertone

colors.name: Carbon Dark
colors.role: Primary heading and navigation text — the darkest text value (rgb 23, 26, 32), used for model names, nav labels, and hero titles on light backgrounds

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Body text and secondary content (rgb 57, 60, 65) — the default paragraph color, slightly warmer than pure gray

colors.name: Pewter
colors.role: Tertiary text for sub-links, secondary navigation links like "Learn" and "Order" (rgb 92, 94, 98)

colors.name: Silver Fog
colors.role: Placeholder text in input fields and disabled states (rgb 142, 142, 142)
